Our Services

Pest & weed control, all in one place

From crawling pests to scorpions, termites to weeds — one local team handles it all.

General Pest Control

General control of the crawling and flying pests found throughout Southern Arizona — for homes and businesses.

Termite Control

Termite control plans for termites, carpenter bees, carpenter ants, and wood-boring beetles — with a five-year warranty.

Scorpion Control

Scorpions are more than creepy crawlies — they can be a serious concern. Tailored solutions using safe, effective methods.

Rodent Control

Mice and packrats carry disease and damage property. Our effective approach keeps them out.

Bee & Hive Removal

Protect your family from dangerous bee stings with hive removal and control — with emergency response when you need it.

Weed Control

Quarterly and monthly weed control plans that make lawn care easier — plus industrial weed abatement that protects remote sites from wildfire.

About Wildcat

Local, family-owned, and here since 2005

Wildcat Exterminating protects homes and businesses across Southern Arizona. We’re a local, family-owned and operated business — and we’re big enough to handle residential or commercial jobs of any size.
